name: docker
description: Inspect containers, logs, and local images through an existing Docker daemon connection. Partial community schema; container lifecycle, builds, exec, Compose, and registry writes are excluded.

commands.name: container ls
commands.description: List running containers, or include stopped containers with --all.

args.name: --format
args.description: Go template applied to each container.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: A table by default; {{json .}} emits one JSON object per container, not an array.

commands.name: container inspect
commands.description: Read metadata for one or more containers.

args.name: container
args.description: One or more container names or IDs.

args.name: --format
args.description: Format each result with a Go template.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: A JSON array of container metadata by default; --format changes the output.

commands.name: container logs
commands.description: Retrieve container logs. Availability depends on the logging driver; bound output with --tail or --since.

args.name: --tail
args.description: Number of trailing lines, or all.

args.name: --since
args.description: Timestamp or relative duration, such as 10m.

args.name: --follow
args.description: Keep streaming new logs until interrupted.

output_fields.name: stdout/stderr
output_fields.description: Container log streams; content depends on the application and TTY configuration.

commands.name: image ls
commands.description: List images stored by the connected Docker daemon.

args.name: repository[:tag]
args.description: Restrict results to a repository and optional tag.

args.name: --format
args.description: Go template applied to each image.

output_fields.name: stdout
output_fields.description: A table by default; {{json .}} emits one JSON object per image row, not an array.
